meaning: Sets mu2_Pa_v, the centre of the second of three components in the Pa_v pressure drive shape used by Model_3_celia. Moving it shifts where that middle component sits along its argument, so it re-places part of the driving waveform.

could_move.what: The Pa_v waveform itself, since mu2 sits between A2_Pa_v and sigma2_Pa_v in the same three-component block
Any Model_3 solve that consumes this parameter set
Comparison decks placing model output against patient data

expectation: Unknown. The static reach trace does not show how mu2_Pa_v enters the equations, so I cannot tell the sign or size of the effect, nor confirm that Model_3_celia is on the path of the listed decks.

check.why: A single listed Model_3 entry point that plots rather than re-fits, so it shows whether the waveform and the bistability picture moved, at one-case cost.
